artworks.title: Cadmus and the Spartoi
artworks.description: Woodcut for Ovid's Metamorphoses: Cadmus sows the dragon's teeth and the armed Spartoi rise to slaughter one another. Echion is among the five survivors who become Thebes' founding nobles — and, by Agave, father of Pentheus.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book 3: the sown men fight; Echion survives to marry Agave and father Pentheus — the Spartos whose house Dionysus will later tear apart.

popCulture.title: Echion
popCulture.description: Spartos of Thebes, husband of Agave and father of Pentheus — distinct from Echion son of Hermes the Argonaut.
